name: Handing off
when: Passing work to another agent or a person

variants.name: Baton
variants.desc: Throws a baton over to a buddy, who catches it.

variants.name: Envelope
variants.desc: Sends an envelope across to a buddy.

variants.name: Pass along
variants.desc: An arrow draws from it to a buddy, who hops.

variants.name: Tag
variants.desc: Bumps a buddy: tag, you are it.

variants.name: To a person
variants.desc: Hands a card to a person, who gets a green dot.
